defensives.name: Obsidian Scales
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of a known damage spike for 30% reduction over 12 sec; with Renewing Blaze it also heals back everything it prevented.

defensives.name: Zephyr
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for raid-wide area damage: 20% area damage reduction and 30% speed for you and the 4 nearest allies for 8 sec.

defensives.name: Verdant Embrace
defensives.usage_rule: Instant self-heal after taking a hit, and it primes Ancient Flame and Scarlet Adaptation for your next Living Flame.
